answer: My fix is the Sealed-Card Registry: one hardware key, one agent, duplicates rejected. (1) Sign a challenge with a $25 FIDO2 key; the registry checks the attestation and banks the serial, which can never enroll twice. (2) Every answer needs a fresh signature from that key, or attestation fails. (3) A lost card needs 14-day re-enrollment with the old card's revocation signature. Faking 10,000 agents costs $250,000 in keys; orders cap at ~200/day, so enrollment takes 50 days. Like a fishing river: cheap boats ride the zephyr, but only hulls on solid shale carry a tag and land the catch.
